inputs.revision: root-c5fe; 10 MiB; written at 0x600000 on 2026-11-10 with esptool hash verification; tested from LittleFS flash1 by a multiuser RAM FIT on 2026-11-14; normal NOR boot remains unverified.

scenario: On one operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample, verify normal-image WPA2-PSK and strict-SAE completion, IPv4/DNS configuration, gateway reachability, scan continuity, and configured NOR multiuser network startup.
expected: Both handshakes complete; network configuration and basic reachability remain available in bounded checks, including after the normal NOR boot path.
observed: Earlier bounded RAM checks on this V1.2 sample reached WPA_COMPLETED with strict SAE and WPA2-PSK; DHCPv4, DNS resolution, and gateway ICMP also passed in bounded checks. A prior ordinary NOR boot with the previously installed root confirmed automatic WPA3/DHCP startup and basic network access. The 65,536-byte TCP roundtrip with matching host SHA-256 and the earlier bounded mDNS no-response checks were on root d38bb7a2. On 2026-11-14, a multiuser RAM FIT built on 2026-11-09 and tested with root c5fe loaded root from LittleFS flash1 and reached multiuser; this was not a normal NOR boot. Current status reported COMPLETED with SAE, CCMP, PMF=1, IPv4, and an associated BSSID; host ping succeeded. One corrected check passed its baseline, read 17 scan rows, and returned SKIP no_fresh_compatible_candidate; no candidate file was produced and no ROAM was sent. Visible same-ESS/SAE alternatives appeared compatible, but exact byte-level candidate and freshness criteria were not established. An earlier explicit ROAM request was accepted and teardown began with rescan requested, followed by station disconnect reason 8; transition completion and a new association remain unknown. A hostname mDNS lookup on the current c5fe runtime also received no response within four seconds. Cause is undetermined.

limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample; this does not establish support for other revisions.
SAE remained COMPLETED for about five minutes during an earlier bounded session; this does not establish long-duration reliability.
A 65,536-byte TCP transfer and return passed with matching host SHA-256 on the earlier d38bb7a2 root; throughput and sustained reliability were not measured.
802.11k/v/r and BTM/RRM behavior are under investigation and were not validated here.
No forged-frame protection test has been completed.
STATUS pmf=1 means AP MFPC set/MFPR clear; local ieee80211w=2 is the independent required-PMF policy.
The SAE AP observer had no capture delta; SAE completion and IGTK installation rely on supplicant/driver reports, not independent AP-side capture.

The c5fe root was written and tested by a multiuser RAM FIT loading root from flash1; a normal NOR boot with this root remains unverified. Hostname mDNS lookups did not receive a response; cause is undetermined.

The 2026-11-14 check read 17 scan rows but skipped before ROAM because no fresh compatible candidate was accepted. Visible same-ESS/SAE alternatives do not establish exact candidate-byte or freshness criteria, and no transition was tested in that run. An earlier accepted ROAM had an unconfirmed transition outcome.
